_description: Tier-1 vendor-supplied cabinet GLB registry. Map a cabinet template or SKU to the .glb file (in this directory) that the Three.js viewport should render INSTEAD of the per-panel BoxGeometry. Lookup order in cabinet_glb_loader.esm.js: exact SKU (e.g. SB-BASE-1DR-30) -> template key (e.g. sb-base-1dr) -> null (fall back to BoxGeometry).
_units: millimetres — every GLB must be modelled in mm; the loader does not rescale.
